verdict.rationale: A public register portal could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. A direct probe returned HTTP 404 for llms.txt on handelsregister.de, and the documentation evidence covers only human-facing search and portal pages. Nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented documentation.
